claim: Portable VM product restore consumes VM Portability Plan refusal rows
promotionEffect: Adds a product-path refusal gate for Portable VM Manifest / VM Portability Plan rows. The refusal is pre-boot and does not broaden the selected whole-VM claim.

proofs.proves: machinen restore consumes a generated VM Portability Plan and refuses active network stream rows before target VM boot with portable-vm-active-network-stream-unsupported.
proofs.claimUse: product refusal evidence for selected portable VM plan handling; arbitrary VM restore remains unclaimed
proofs.next: Expand product plan refusals with retained dirty DB, unknown process, opaque device, and active syscall product-command transcripts.
